name: Spinach Ricotta Cannelloni
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C. Wilt washed spinach in a covered pan, cool, squeeze very dry and chop finely.
Soften chopped garlic in oil, add passata, water, basil and half the salt; simmer for 8 minutes.
Mix spinach with ricotta, nutmeg, pepper and remaining salt. Spoon or pipe the filling into dry cannelloni tubes.
Spread half the sauce in a baking dish, arrange the filled tubes and cover completely with remaining sauce and mozzarella.
Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake 10 minutes until the pasta is tender. Rest before serving.
tips: Choose oven-ready egg-free cannelloni and vegetarian ricotta and mozzarella; wet spinach makes the filling runny.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
